attempts.summary: Configured iBGP (AS 65100, extending SONiC's existing instance) between node1 and node2 over a discovered transit link (172.20.0.0/31), so each switch dynamically learns the other's private subnet (192.168.1.0/24 behind node1/node3, 192.168.2.0/24 behind node2/node4) via BGP rather than hand-entered routes. node3 and node4 now reach each other purely via BGP-learned routes. All configuration (interface addressing, forwarding sysctls, BGP peering, and end-host routes) was verified to survive a full reboot of each of the 4 managed nodes, restarted one at a time with confirmed boot-identity changes and post-restart recovery.
